android-forms|OutlinedTextField.summary: AI conversation additions use existing controls, retain drafts and mark generated output without a new color.

variants.name: PromptInput: Single line
variants.use: Write, attach context and choose an available model before explicitly sending a prompt.
variants.compose: Enter sends once; Shift+Enter starts a line. IME composition does not submit. Failed requests retain the draft; Stop delegates transport cancellation.
